rules.name: Brute Force Detection
rules.description: Detects multiple failed logon attempts within a short time window on a single account.

rules.name: Impossible Travel Security Anomaly
rules.description: Flags logins from distinct geolocations at a velocity physically impossible by aircraft travel.

rules.name: Dormant Account Authentication Alert
rules.description: Alerts on any logon activity from user accounts that have been inactive for over 90 days.

rules.name: Administrative Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Detects unauthorized additions to administrative groups or privilege alterations.

rules.name: MFA Bypass / Session Manipulation
rules.description: Detects logins where MFA requirement was bypassed or disabled on privileged accounts.

rules.name: Service Account Anomaly Detection
rules.description: Detects service account authentication from unexpected subnets or non-standard hours.

rules.name: Distributed Password Spraying Attack
rules.description: Identifies failed logon attempts across multiple accounts coming from the same source IP.

rules.name: OAuth Token Abuse / Hijacking
rules.description: Flags active session token actions originating from unexpected networks or devices.
